abstract: We explain the empirical puzzle why mergers reduce profits, and raise share prices. If being an 'insider' is better than being an 'outsider', firms may merge to preempt their partner merging with a rival. The stock-value is increased, since the risk of becoming an outsider is eliminated. We also show that mergers increasing consumers' prices, while increasing competitors' profits, may reduce the competitors' share-prices. Thus, event-studies may not detect anti-competitive mergers. These results are derived in an endogenous-merger model, predicting the conditions under which mergers occur, the time of merger, and the split of surplus.
abstract_zh: 我们解释了为何并购会降低利润却推高股价这一实证谜题。若成为"内部人"优于成为"外部人"，企业可能通过并购先发制人，防止其合作伙伴与竞争对手合并。由于消除了沦为外部人的风险，股票价值得以提升。我们还证明，并购虽会提高消费者价格并增加竞争对手利润，却可能压低竞争对手的股价。因此，事件研究法可能无法识别反竞争性并购。这些结论源于一个内生并购模型，该模型预测了并购发生的条件、时机以及剩余分配方式。
title: Why Mergers Reduce Profits, and Raise Share-Prices
title_zh: 为何并购降低利润，却推高股价

abstract: This paper studies an agency framework in which a principal hires a supervisor to monitor the agent's productive effort. We consider several monitoring technologies which differ in the quantity (frequency) and the quality (accuracy) of the information they deliver. We show that the frequency of monitoring is irrelevant if the supervisor is honest or if the supervisor colludes with the agent but monitoring evidence can only be concealed and not forged. In either case, a first-best can be achieved if monitoring is sufficiently precise even though unbounded punishments are not feasible. Finally, if monitoring evidence can be falsified, the principal benefits both from the frequency and the accuracy of the supervisor's observations. This is the only case in which collusion imposes an additional cost on the relationship. The findings suggest that it is strictly better for the principal to monitor the agent's action rather than testing for an unknown ability or technology parameter.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个委托代理框架，其中委托人雇佣监督者来监控代理人的生产性努力。我们考虑了多种监控技术，这些技术在所传递信息的数量（频率）和质量（准确性）上存在差异。研究表明，如果监督者是诚实的，或者监督者与代理人合谋但监控证据只能被隐藏而无法伪造，那么监控频率无关紧要。在这两种情况下，只要监控足够精确，即使无法实施无限惩罚，也能实现最优结果。最后，如果监控证据可以被伪造，委托人将从监督者观察的频率和准确性中同时获益。这是合谋对委托-代理关系施加额外成本的唯一情形。研究结果表明，对委托人而言，监控代理人的行为严格优于测试其未知能力或技术参数。
title: Optimal Monitoring in Hierarchical Relationships
title_zh: 层级关系中的最优监督
